evals.prompt: I want to write about how I stopped cramming everything into CLAUDE.md and started moving stuff into skills instead. Notes: root CLAUDE.md got to ~900 lines on one client repo, agent started ignoring rules near the bottom, moved workflows into 6 skills, CLAUDE.md now ~120 lines, still not sure skills trigger reliably. Not sure if this is one post or a series.
evals.expected_output: A draft brief: candidate one-liners, reader, tension, a shape decision (one post vs series) argued from the evidence, 2-3 arcs with beats, turning points, emphasis plan, honesty beats including the unreliable triggering, and 'author to supply' marks where evidence is missing (e.g. what 'ignoring rules' looked like). No body prose.
assertions: Offers two or three candidate one-liners for the point, rather than one
Names the reader: who they are, what they believe now, what should change
States the tension explicitly
Proposes at least two arcs written as numbered beats, and recommends one with a reason
Marks turning points as what the reader should see or do, not how to build a visual
Includes honesty beats (what isn't solved or what went wrong first)
Marks missing evidence as 'author to supply' (or equivalent) instead of inventing facts, numbers or anecdotes
Contains no drafted body paragraphs of the post
Argues the one-post-vs-series decision from the evidence in the notes
Plans an honesty beat around skills not triggering reliably
